top_signals.title: Bond Selloff May Mean Fewer Rate Hikes From Global Central Banks
top_signals.summary: Bond markets are starting to do some of the lifting for central banks around the world by pushing up borrowing costs themselves, potentially reducing the number of benchmark interest-rate hikes needed to get inflation under control.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Policy paper: Chancellor meeting with Gilt-edged Market Makers: Minutes - October 2026
top_signals.summary: Summary minutes of the Chancellor of the Exchequer’s meeting with the primary dealer firms in the gilt market, on 6 October 2026 in HM Treasury.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Gov. Koike's Nest Key Priorities for Tokyo
top_signals.summary: Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike has spent the last decade driving transformative reforms—from pioneering climate initiatives and universal childcare support to guiding the metropolis through the COVID-19 pandemic and the 2020 Olympic Games. Looking to the future, Koike sits down with Bloomberg’s Shery Ahn at Bloomberg's Tokyo Studio to exclusively discuss her key strategic priorities. (Source: Bloomberg)
